name: handover
description: Handover notes before the context fills up: starts the handover at a threshold, asks about state before writing, captures the rules you set into .claude/rules, and restores the note after compaction or /clear.

threshold.title: Handover threshold
threshold.description: Offer a handover when the context is this full (0.7 = 70%).

window.title: Context window (tokens)
window.description: Context window of the model you use. Set to 1000000 for 1M-context models.

fresh_minutes.title: Note freshness (minutes)
fresh_minutes.description: If the handover note is older than this when auto-compaction starts, compaction is paused once.
